cards.originalTitle: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
cards.titleEn: QATFactory: A Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-Aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces QATFactory, an open-source framework that simulates deployment-time quantization while running matrix multiplications in BF16, allowing models to adapt to quantization noise without training hardware that natively supports the target format. It exports checkpoints directly to vLLM and llama.cpp, aiming to reduce lossy conversion and added inference overhead.
cards.whyItMattersEn: When deployment-side low-precision formats are disconnected from training, quality loss from quantization may only surface at inference time. QATFactory moves deployment quantization noise into training and distillation and exports directly to production inference engines, offering an engineering path toward training-deployment alignment for low-precision LLMs; it also suggests that the optimal quantization training strategy may vary with the target format rather than being a universal fixed recipe.
keyPoints: QATFactory在BF16中模拟部署时量化，支持在无FP4 Tensor Core的H100上进行NVFP4训练，并覆盖NVFP4、MXFP4和llama.cpp Q4_K格式。
框架支持稠密与混合专家模型、全参数与LoRA训练，导出checkpoint可直接用于vLLM和llama.cpp，无需额外有损转换或增加推理开销。
实验显示QAD在Qwen3.5-9B上NVFP4平均准确率68.9%、MXFP4为66.0%，分别高于最佳PTQ的65.4%和56.4%；且最佳训练策略因格式而异。
cards.summaryEn: LLM inference is moving toward lower precision to exploit hardware accelerator throughput, but aggressive post-training quantization can degrade model quality. QATFactory unifies deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation and reinforcement learning in an open-source framework that simulates deployment quantization under BF16 matrix multiplications, letting models adapt to quantization noise during training. The authors report that across 8B to 230B models, QAD consistently improves deployed-model quality over strong PTQ baselines, and that the best training strategy depends on the target FP4 format.
cards.summary: 大模型推理正转向低精度以利用硬件加速器吞吐，但强力量化后训练可能损害模型质量。QATFactory将部署对齐的量化感知蒸馏与强化学习统一到一个开源框架中，在BF16矩阵乘法下模拟部署量化，让模型在训练阶段适应量化噪声。作者报告在8B至230B模型上，QAD在部署引擎中的质量一致优于强PTQ基线，并观察到最优训练策略取决于目标FP4格式。
cards.limitations: 证据来自arXiv预印本与作者自建实验，尚未经过独立复现或同行评审；结论覆盖8B至230B参数模型及NVFP4、MXFP4、Q4_K等特定格式，向其他模型规模、量化格式或推理引擎的外推需谨慎。文中的准确率比较基于特定基准与训练token预算，不同数据分布或硬件环境可能改变最优策略。该框架的实际部署收益还依赖目标推理引擎与硬件支持情况。
keyPointsEn: QATFactory simulates deployment-time quantization in BF16, supports NVFP4 training on H100 GPUs without FP4 Tensor Cores, and covers NVFP4, MXFP4, and llama.cpp's Q4_K format.

It supports dense and mixture-of-experts models as well as full-parameter and LoRA training, and exports checkpoints directly to vLLM and llama.cpp without an additional lossy conversion step or added inference overhead.
On Qwen3.5-9B, QAD achieves average accuracies of 68.9% under NVFP4 and 66.0% under MXFP4, versus best PTQ results of 65.4% and 56.4%; the best training strategy is format-dependent.
cards.description: 该工作提出开源框架QATFactory，通过在BF16下模拟部署时量化，使模型无需目标格式原生算力即可适配NVFP4、MXFP4等低精度噪声，并直接导出至vLLM与llama.cpp。其价值在于打通训练与部署之间的格式鸿沟，减少有损转换与额外推理开销。
cards.title: QATFactory：面向部署对齐的LLM量化感知训练与蒸馏框架
cards.whyItMatters: 若部署端低精度格式与训练过程脱节，量化后模型质量损失往往只能在推理阶段暴露。QATFactory把部署量化噪声前移到训练与蒸馏环节，并直接导出到生产推理引擎，为低精度LLM的落地提供了一条训练与部署对齐的工程路径；同时提示最优量化训练策略可能随目标格式变化，而非通用固定方案。
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes from an arXiv preprint and the authors' own experiments, without independent replication or peer review. Conclusions cover models from 8B to 230B parameters and specific formats such as NVFP4, MXFP4, and Q4_K; extrapolation to other model scales, quantization formats, or inference engines requires caution. Reported accuracy comparisons rely on specific benchmarks and training token budgets, and different data distributions or hardware environments may change the optimal strategy. Practical deployment gains also depend on target inference engine and hardware support.

cards.titleEn: Agent-Reach: letting AI agents read multi-platform content for free
cards.descriptionEn: The project claims to unify reading and search across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and Xiaohongshu into a single command-line tool without paid APIs. For developers who need to give AI agents broader internet awareness, it offers an integration idea worth evaluating.
cards.whyItMattersEn: AI agents often need to connect to multiple platform data sources for retrieval, monitoring or summarization tasks. If the tool can truly unify these sources in one CLI without API fees, it could lower integration and cost barriers, making it worth developer attention and verification.
keyPoints: 定位是给 AI 代理提供互联网内容读取与搜索能力，覆盖多个主流平台。
交互形态为单一命令行工具，项目自述强调无需支付 API 费用。
出自 GitHub Trending，属于开发者工具方向的开源项目。
cards.summaryEn: Agent-Reach is a GitHub trending project that aims to give AI agents "eyes" to access internet content. The author says a single CLI can read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and Xiaohongshu, claiming zero API fees. Those features and the zero-fee claim come from the project's own description and are not backed by tests or independent verification in the provided material.
cards.summary: Agent-Reach 是一个 GitHub 趋势项目，目标是为 AI 代理提供访问互联网内容的“眼睛”。作者称其通过单一 CLI 即可读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书，并宣称零 API 费用。上述功能与“零费用”描述来自项目自述，尚未在输入材料中给出实测或独立验证。
cards.limitations: 输入仅包含项目名称与来源摘要，没有版本号、星标数、许可证、依赖环境、平台适配方式或测试结果。摘要中“读取和搜索多个平台”“零 API 费用”均为项目自述，未提供可核验证据，也未说明是否违反各平台服务条款、是否存在封禁或限流风险。不应据此推断其稳定性、合规性或实际可用性，也不构成任何投资或采用建议。
keyPointsEn: Positioned to give AI agents internet content reading and search capabilities across multiple major platforms.
Delivered as a single command-line tool, with the project claiming no paid API costs.
Comes from GitHub Trending and is an open-source developer-tool project.
cards.description: 该项目把 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台的读取与搜索能力统一到一个命令行工具中，强调不依赖付费 API。对需要为 AI 代理补充互联网感知能力的开发者而言，它提供了一个可评估的集成思路。
cards.title: Agent-Reach：让 AI 代理免费读取多平台内容
cards.whyItMatters: AI 代理若要完成检索、监控或信息汇总类任务，常需接入多个平台的数据接口；若该工具确能在单一 CLI 中统一这些来源且不产生 API 费用，可降低集成与成本门槛，因此值得开发者关注和验证。
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only the project name and source summary, with no version, star count, license, dependency requirements, platform integration method or test results. The claims of reading and searching multiple platforms and zero API fees are the project's own description, with no verifiable evidence, and it does not state whether it violates platform terms of service or carries ban or rate-limit risks. It should not be used to infer stability, compliance or practical usability, and it is not investment or adoption advice.

cards.titleEn: Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Voxel-Based 3D Mapping
cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes allocating voxel resolution using semantic entropy, geometric curvature, and texture richness as scene complexity cues, and employs a reinforcement learning agent to learn subdivision policies under a user-specified memory budget instead of hand-tuned thresholds. Its novelty lies in avoiding reliance on semantic taxonomies and reducing the accuracy-memory trade-off to a single control parameter; on synthetic and real-world datasets it reports improved geome
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible across broader settings, this approach could shift the accuracy-memory trade-off in 3D mapping from expert tuning to a single memory budget parameter, lowering the barrier to adaptive mapping and potentially improving resource efficiency in complex environments for robotics and reconstruction systems.
keyPoints: 以语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索，不依赖语义类别列表即可分配体素分辨率。
引入强化学习智能体，在用户指定目标内存预算下学习体素细分策略，替代手工调参阈值。
在合成与真实数据集上报告了相对于MAP-ADAPT和固定分辨率基线的几何精度、语义一致性及内存-精度权衡改进。
cards.summaryEn: The paper addresses the memory inefficiency of fixed-resolution voxel mapping and the expert tuning and lack of explicit memory control in existing adaptive methods by proposing an adaptive framework. It uses semantic entropy, geometric curvature, and texture richness as scene complexity cues to decide voxel subdivision, and introduces a reinforcement learning agent that learns subdivision policies under a user-specified memory budget. The authors report higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs for the resulting multi-resolution TSDF, with code and models released.
cards.summary: 论文针对固定分辨率体素建图内存效率低、现有自适应方法依赖专家调参且无法控制内存的问题，提出一种自适应框架。该框架用语义熵、几何曲率与纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索决定体素细分，并引入强化学习智能体在用户给定内存预算下学习细分策略。作者报告该方法在多分辨率TSDF上取得更高的几何精度、更好的语义一致性以及更优的内存-精度权衡，代码与模型已公开。
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者在特定合成与真实数据集上的对比实验，未说明跨数据集、跨传感器或跨场景类别的泛化边界；强化学习策略的训练成本、收敛稳定性及对目标内存预算设定的敏感性未在摘要中给出；所谓更高的几何精度、语义一致性和更优权衡均为作者报告，尚需独立复现与更广泛基线验证；该方法是否能推广到动态场景或大规模环境仍不明确。
keyPointsEn: Uses semantic entropy, geometric curvature, and texture richness as scene complexity cues to allocate voxel resolution without relying on semantic class lists.
Introduces a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds.
Reports improvements in geometric accuracy, semantic consistency, and memory-accuracy trade-offs over MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on synthetic and real-world datasets.
cards.description: 该工作提出以语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索来分配体素分辨率，并用强化学习智能体在用户指定内存预算下学习细分策略，替代手工阈值。其新意在于不依赖语义分类体系，将精度-内存权衡简化为单一控制参数，并在合成与真实数据集上报告了优于MAP-ADAPT和固定分辨率基线的几何精度、语义一致性和内存-精度权衡。
cards.title: 基于语义熵与强化学习的自适应体素三维建图
cards.whyItMatters: 若该方法在更广泛场景中可复现，将有助于把三维建图中的精度与内存权衡从依赖专家调参转变为由单一内存预算参数控制，降低自适应建图的使用门槛，并可能提升机器人与重建系统在复杂环境中的资源利用效率。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' comparisons on specific synthetic and real-world datasets; generalization across datasets, sensors, or scene categories is not established. Training cost, convergence stability, and sensitivity to the target memory budget of the reinforcement learning policy are not detailed in the abstract. The reported higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved trade-offs are author-reported and require independent replication and broader baseline validation. Whether the method extends to dynamic scenes or large-scale environments remains unclear.

cards.originalTitle: Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies
cards.titleEn: One-Step Flow Policies Accelerate Online Multi-Agent Coordination
cards.descriptionEn: The OMAF framework combines expressive flow-based generative policies with one-step action generation, avoiding the iterative sampling cost of diffusion policies and offering a more efficient yet expressive policy paradigm for online multi-agent reinforcement learning.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Online multi-agent reinforcement learning demands high sample efficiency in both training and execution. If one-step flow policies can significantly reduce sampling cost without sacrificing expressiveness, they may help scale complex generative policies to more practical coordinated decision-making settings.
keyPoints: OMAF 采用 Transformer 流策略实现一步动作生成，消除扩散策略的迭代采样开销。
提出近似路径得分替代，为同步流策略优化提供原则性途径。
联合优化方案耦合 softmax Q 值估计与联合流策略目标，以提升稳定性和样本效率。
cards.summaryEn: In multi-agent reinforcement learning, diffusion-based generative policies can model complex multimodal action distributions but incur costly iterative sampling. OMAF uses a Transformer-based flow policy for one-step action generation, coupled with an approximate path score surrogate and a joint optimization scheme, to reduce training overhead in online multi-agent settings. On 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo, it reports better returns and sample efficiency than baselines.
cards.summary: 多智能体强化学习中，扩散类生成策略能建模复杂多模态动作分布，但迭代采样代价高。OMAF 用基于 Transformer 的流策略实现一步动作生成，并配合近似路径得分替代与联合优化方案，在在线多智能体设定下降低训练开销。在 MPE 与 MAMuJoCo 的 10 个标准任务上，其回报与样本效率优于基线。
cards.limitations: 证据来自 arXiv 预印本，仅摘要：实验限于 MPE 与 MAMuJoCo 的 10 个标准任务；未说明理论保证、真实系统验证、计算资源细节与失败案例；“3.4 倍回报”“10.5 倍样本效率”为相对基线的报告值，需独立复现验证。
keyPointsEn: OMAF uses a Transformer-based flow policy for one-step action generation, eliminating the iterative sampling overhead of diffusion policies.
It introduces an approximate path score surrogate that provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization.
A joint optimization scheme couples softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective to improve stability and sample efficiency.
cards.description: 该工作提出的 OMAF 框架将表达性强的流生成策略与一步动作生成结合，避免了扩散策略迭代采样的开销，为在线多智能体强化学习提供了一种更高效且不牺牲表达能力的策略范式。
cards.title: 一步流策略加速在线多智能体协同学习
cards.whyItMatters: 在线多智能体强化学习对训练和执行的采样效率要求高。若一步流策略能在不牺牲表达性的前提下显著降低采样成本，将有助于把复杂生成策略扩展到更实际的协同决策场景。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is from an arXiv preprint and its abstract only: experiments are limited to 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo; no theoretical guarantees, real-system validation, compute details, or failure cases are described; the reported '3.4x higher returns' and '10.5x sample efficiency improvement' are relative to baselines and require independent replication.

cards.originalTitle: CHILLGuard: Towards Fine-Grained Chinese LLM Safety Guardrail with Scalable Data Construction and Model-aware Preference Alignment
cards.titleEn: Fine-Grained Chinese LLM Safety Guardrail with Scalable Data Construction and Model-Aware Preference Alignment
cards.descriptionEn: This paper introduces a 5-macro, 31-micro fine-grained risk taxonomy for Chinese scenarios and builds CHILLGuard, a dedicated Chinese LLM safety guardrail, with a scalable multi-stage data construction pipeline. It is useful for engineering teams needing Chinese content safety and risk-tiered deployment, though primary evidence comes from the authors' own benchmark.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Chinese content safety requires adaptation to local regulatory policies, cultural context, and linguistic nuances, while existing guardrails mostly target English or multilingual settings and struggle with fine-grained risk tiers. This work offers a taxonomy, data pipeline, and dedicated model to help stakeholders perform more granular risk identification and governance in Chinese deployment scenarios.
keyPoints: 提出中文场景5宏类、31微类细粒度风险分类体系。
用检索增强生成、隐式有害样本改写与多模型投票校准构建405,007训练样本和51,745测试样本。
在自建基准上F1相对Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict提升15.92%，资源已开源。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The paper proposes a 5-macro, 31-micro risk taxonomy for Chinese scenarios and builds CHILLGuardTrain (405,007 samples) and CHILLGuardTest (51,745 samples) via retrieval-augmented generation expansion, prompt-engineering implicit harmful sample generation, and multi-model voting label calibration. The model is trained under a generator-classifier collaborative framework using Model-aware Direct Preference Optimization, achieving a 15.92% relative F1 improvement over Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict on the authors' benchmark. Author view: this approach addresses Chinese regulatory policies, cultural context, and linguistic nuances while supporting fine-grained risk classification for deployment needs.
cards.summary: 事实：论文提出中文场景的5宏类、31微类风险分类，并构建CHILLGuardTrain（405,007样本）与CHILLGuardTest（51,745样本），通过检索增强生成扩展语料、提示工程生成隐式有害样本、多模型投票校准标签。模型在生成器-分类器协作框架下用Model-aware Direct Preference Optimization训练，在自建基准上相对Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict的F1提升15.92%。作者观点：该路线可应对中文监管政策、文化语境与语言细微差异，并支持细粒度风险分类部署需求。
cards.limitations: 证据边界：主要结论基于作者自建CHILLGuardTest基准，15.92%的相对提升是相对Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict的单一对比，不代表在所有中文安全任务或真实线上流量中同样成立。风险分类体系可能随监管政策与文化语境变化而需要更新，数据构造依赖多模型投票与提示工程，可能继承上游模型偏差或覆盖盲区。开源信息为论文自述，未提供独立复现与跨域泛化证据。
keyPointsEn: Introduces a 5-macro, 31-micro fine-grained risk taxonomy for Chinese scenarios.
Builds 405,007 training samples and 51,745 test samples using retrieval-augmented generation, implicit harmful sample rewriting, and multi-model voting calibration.
Reports a 15.92% relative F1 improvement over Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict on the authors' benchmark, with open-sourced resources.
cards.description: 该研究提出了面向中文场景的5大类31小类细粒度风险分类体系，并构建了大规模中文安全数据集与专用护栏模型CHILLGuard。其新意在于用可扩展的多阶段数据构造缓解中文安全标注稀缺，并以模型感知偏好对齐训练护栏；对需要中文内容安全部署与风险分级的工程团队有参考价值。
cards.title: 中文大模型安全护栏细粒度分类与数据构建
cards.whyItMatters: 中文内容安全需要适配本地监管政策、文化语境和语言细微差异，现有护栏多面向英文或多语言，难以支持细粒度风险分级。该工作提供了分类体系、数据流水线与专用模型，可帮助相关方在中文部署场景中做更细粒度的风险识别与治理。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: The main results are based on the authors' self-built CHILLGuardTest benchmark, and the 15.92% relative improvement is a single comparison against Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict, not evidence that it holds across all Chinese safety tasks or real online traffic. The risk taxonomy may need updates as regulatory policies and cultural contexts evolve, and data construction relies on multi-model voting and prompt engineering, which may inherit upstream model biases or coverage gaps. Open-source claims are author-reported, without independent reproduction or cross-domain generalization evidence.

cards.originalTitle: Admissible Portfolio Optimization: Information Constraints, Conditional Efficient Frontiers, and the Price of Causal Identification
cards.titleEn: Admissible Portfolio Optimization: Information Constraints, Conditional Efficient Frontiers, and the Price of Causal Identification
cards.descriptionEn: The study treats conditioning information as a decision variable subject to pre-declared admissibility constraints rather than a given input; it shows that enlarging the search reduces the defect on individual equities but is nearly ineffective on pre-diversified portfolios, and reveals an explicit oracle price traded against search complexity for causal identification.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a theoretical framework for distinguishing usable information from causal information in quantitative portfolio construction, helping avoid look-ahead bias and misclassifying common risk, while clarifying the statistical cost of causal identification; the empirical results indicate that the constraint’s applicability depends on whether assets are already well diversified.
keyPoints: 将条件信息作为决策变量，建立可采纳性约束的字典序选择框架，并证明存在性、重编码不变性与可采纳信息价值定理。
理论揭示按决策损失选择信息会接纳前视信息，而干预性可采纳性下可分散风险才具干预稳定性，因果识别对应明确的预言机价格与搜索复杂度权衡。
在127个候选驱动因子的市场数据中，约束在个体股票上可达、扩大搜索降低缺陷，在预分散化组合上几乎无效。
cards.summaryEn: Mean–variance portfolio choice typically takes conditioning information as given and optimizes only weights, so two errors pass into the portfolio unseen: using variables unavailable at decision time and treating common variation as idiosyncratic. The author makes conditioning information a decision variable under hard admissibility constraints declared in advance—availability, a no-arbitrage-preserving enlargement of the decision filtration, statistical separation, and invariance across declared regimes for interventional claims—selects an optimal information class by a lexicographic order, and then solves the classical problem within it. Theory shows that selection by decision loss admits look-ahead information whenever present, while causal identification carries an explicit oracle price; empirically, the constraint is attainable on individual equities, where enlarging the search reduces the defect at a measurable rate, but not on pre-diversified portfolios, where it is nearly invariant to the search.
cards.summary: 均值-方差组合选择通常将条件信息视为给定并仅优化权重，使两个错误悄然进入组合：使用决策时不可得的变量，以及将共同变异误认为特异性。作者将条件信息本身作为决策变量，施加可事先声明的硬可采纳性约束（可用性、保持无套利的决策滤子扩张、统计分离性、干预下的跨状态不变性），并以字典序选择最优信息类，再在其中求解经典问题。理论证明选择依据决策损失时会接纳前视信息，而因果识别要求带来显式的预言机价格；实证显示约束在个体股票上可达，在预分散化组合上几乎不变，失败时协方差仍可产生低换手的最小方差组合。
cards.limitations: 作者观点与实证结论需区分：可采纳性约束的实际效果依赖预先声明的状态划分与分离性假设，在预分散化组合上缺陷几乎不随搜索变化，说明约束对共同因子主导残差依赖的场景适用性有限；因果识别价格与二阶遗憾为理论结果，未在文中报告跨市场、跨时期的稳健性检验；最小方差组合与收缩法的比较基于特定数据，换手率与风险分解结论不宜直接外推。
keyPointsEn: Treats conditioning information as a decision variable and builds a lexicographic admissibility framework, proving existence, invariance under recodings, and a value-of-admissible-information theorem.

Theory reveals that selection by decision loss admits look-ahead information when present, and that interventionally stable diversifiable risk under interventional admissibility is tied to an explicit oracle price traded against search complexity.

On market data with 127 candidate drivers, the condition is attainable on individual equities and enlarging the search reduces the defect, but it is nearly invariant to the search on pre-diversified portfolios.
cards.description: 该研究将条件信息视为需事先声明可采纳性约束的决策变量，而非既定输入；证明在个体股票上扩大搜索可降低缺陷率，但在预分散化组合上几乎无效，并揭示因果识别对应的显式预言机价格与搜索复杂度的权衡。
cards.title: 投资组合优化中的信息可采纳性约束与因果识别代价
cards.whyItMatters: 为量化组合构建提供了区分可用信息与因果信息的理论框架，有助于避免前视偏差和误判共同风险，并明确因果识别所需付出的统计代价；实证结果提示约束的适用场景依赖于资产是否已充分分散化。
cards.limitationsEn: Author’s views and empirical findings must be distinguished: the practical effect of admissibility constraints depends on pre-declared regime partitions and separation assumptions; on pre-diversified portfolios the defect is nearly invariant to the search, indicating limited applicability when residual dependence is dominated by common factors; the causal identification price and second-order regret are theoretical results without reported robustness checks across markets or periods; the comparison of minimum-variance portfolios with shrinkage is based on specific data, and turnover and risk decomposition conclusions should not be directly extrapolated.

cards.originalTitle: Tokenized Key-Gated Adapter Routing: A Secure Access Control Mechanism Against Private Data Leakage in LLMs
cards.titleEn: Tokenized Key-Gated LoRA Routing for Privacy Access Control in LLMs
cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes Locket, a framework that embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control into LLM generation by using keyed entry tokens to route to different LoRA adapters (full reveal, PII redaction, differential privacy), aiming to reduce sensitive data leakage while preserving model utility and access to private knowledge.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If validated more broadly, this approach could offer a scalable, off-the-shelf-compatible path for fine-grained access control in regulated LLM deployments, providing a more flexible mechanism than a single trade-off among utility, privacy, and private knowledge access.
keyPoints: Locket将访问策略编码为多个LoRA适配器，通过序列级硬路由与密钥令牌绑定，实现令牌即授权。
有效令牌解锁私有知识并保持类似无防御微调的困惑度；无效或缺失令牌触发脱敏或差分隐私适配器。
在Enron、ECHR、Yelp数据集及Qwen3、Llama-3.2、Gemma-2等模型上进行了评估。
cards.summaryEn: The study addresses the risk that LLMs deployed in privacy-critical domains may memorize and disclose personally identifiable information, and proposes Locket. Locket trains multiple lightweight LoRA adapters, each encoding a distinct access policy, and uses a gating module to hard-route a valid keyed token to the corresponding adapter; an invalid or absent token triggers a privacy-preserving adapter that redacts sensitive content. Experiments on Enron, ECHR, and Yelp with several models report that with the correct token, perplexity is comparable to fine-tuning without defense, while without a valid token PII leakage is substantially reduced.
cards.summary: 研究针对LLM在医疗、金融等隐私敏感场景中可能记忆并泄露PII的问题，提出Locket框架。该框架训练多个轻量LoRA适配器，分别编码不同访问策略，并用门控模块将有效密钥令牌硬路由到对应适配器；无效或缺失令牌则触发隐私保护适配器进行脱敏。作者在Enron、ECHR、Yelp及多个模型上实验，报告在正确令牌下困惑度接近无防御微调，在无效令牌下显著降低PII泄露。
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者在特定数据集与模型上的实验报告，未涉及独立复现或真实生产部署；不同策略下的隐私保证强度、对抗性令牌攻击、门控模块的鲁棒性以及跨领域泛化能力仍需进一步验证。
keyPointsEn: Locket encodes access policies into multiple LoRA adapters and binds them to keyed tokens via sequence-level hard routing, making the token an authorization key.
A valid token unlocks private knowledge while maintaining perplexity similar to undefended fine-tuning; an invalid or absent token triggers redaction or differential privacy adapters.
Evaluation covers Enron, ECHR, and Yelp datasets and models including Qwen3, Llama-3.2, and Gemma-2.
cards.description: 该研究提出Locket框架，通过在LLM生成过程中嵌入细粒度、策略驱动的访问控制，用密钥令牌触发不同LoRA适配器（完全公开、PII脱敏、差分隐私等），从而在保留模型效用与私有知识访问的同时，减少敏感信息泄露。
cards.title: 基于令牌密钥门控的LoRA路由实现大模型隐私访问控制
cards.whyItMatters: 若该方法在更广泛场景中可验证，可为LLM在受监管行业提供一种兼容现成模型、可扩展的细粒度访问控制路径，在效用、隐私与私有知识访问之间提供比单一权衡更灵活的机制。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' experiments on specific datasets and models, without independent replication or real-world deployment; the strength of privacy guarantees under different policies, robustness against adversarial token attacks, gating module reliability, and cross-domain generalization require further verification.

cards.originalTitle: Modeling Shipping Emissions: Machine Learning, Engineering, and Policy Counterfactuals
cards.titleEn: Machine Learning Predicts Well but Counterfactual Speed Responses Can Be Attenuated: Evidence from Shipping Emissions
cards.descriptionEn: Using maritime CO2 emissions, this study compares engineering calculations, structural regressions, hybrid models, and machine learning. All estimated models predict reported totals within a few percent out of sample, yet pure machine learning and unrestricted structural regression imply attenuated speed responses. Its value is showing that accurate aggregate prediction cannot substitute for scrutiny of the restrictions determining counterfactual responses, and that hybrids p
cards.whyItMattersEn: The authors use a cost-benefit analysis to show that an attenuated speed response can flip the sign of net benefits; for research using machine learning predictions to support emissions policy evaluation, this means the model restrictions determining counterfactual responses need separate scrutiny rather than reliance on aggregate predictive accuracy alone.
keyPoints: 样本外总量预测：工程计算、结构回归、混合模型与机器学习均可达到与报告总量相差几个百分点的精度，并优于标准工程计算。
反事实响应差异：纯机器学习和无约束结构回归隐含被衰减的速度响应，说明预测精度不保证可靠的反事实响应。
混合模型设计：从机器学习组件中排除与速度相关的输入，可保留结构组件中的速度响应。
cards.summaryEn: The authors match hourly tracking data for dry bulk and container ships to annual fuel consumption reported under EU regulations. They find that all estimated models predict reported totals within a few percent out of sample, outperforming standard engineering calculations. However, pure machine learning and unrestricted structural regression imply attenuated speed responses; the authors' judgment is that hybrids excluding speed-related inputs from the machine learning component preserve the structural component's speed response, and a cost-benefit analysis shows attenuation can flip the sign of net benefits.
cards.summary: 作者发现，在匹配干散货船与集装箱船的小时级追踪数据与欧盟法规下年度燃料消耗报告后，各类估计模型在样本外对报告总量的预测误差仅为几个百分点，优于标准工程计算。但事实是：纯机器学习与无约束结构回归得到的速度响应被衰减；作者的判断是，将速度相关输入从机器学习部分排除的混合模型可保留结构部分的速度响应。成本收益分析示例表明，速度响应被衰减可能改变净收益的符号。
cards.limitations: 证据边界来自原文设定：研究对象限于干散货船与集装箱船，数据为小时级追踪与欧盟法规下年度燃料消耗报告的匹配；结论基于样本外预测比较与速度响应分析，成本收益结果是对速度削减的分析示例，未在输入中给出跨其他船型、其他辖区或更广泛政策组合的验证。
keyPointsEn: Out-of-sample aggregate prediction: engineering calculations, structural regressions, hybrid models, and machine learning all predict reported totals within a few percent, outperforming standard engineering calculations.

Counterfactual response divergence: pure machine learning and unrestricted structural regression imply attenuated speed responses, showing predictive accuracy does not ensure reliable counterfactual responses.
Hybrid model design: excluding speed-related inputs from the machine learning component preserves the speed response in the structural component.
cards.description: 本文以船舶CO2排放为场景，比较工程计算、结构回归、混合模型与纯机器学习，指出现有模型在样本外总量预测上均可达到与报告值相差几个百分点的精度，但纯机器学习与无约束结构回归会给出被衰减的速度响应。其价值在于说明预测准确不能替代对反事实响应约束的审查，并给出混合模型保留结构速度响应的做法。
cards.title: 机器学习预测精度高但反事实响应可能失真：以航运碳排为例
cards.whyItMatters: 作者用成本收益分析说明，速度响应被衰减可能翻转净收益的符号；因此对以机器学习预测支撑减排政策评估的研究而言，需单独检验决定反事实响应的模型约束，而非仅依赖汇总预测精度。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries come from the original setting: the study is limited to dry bulk and container ships, using matched hourly tracking data and annual fuel consumption reported under EU regulations; the conclusions rest on out-of-sample prediction comparisons and speed-response analysis, and the cost-benefit result is an illustrative analysis of speed reductions, with no validation across other ship types, jurisdictions, or broader policy mixes provided in the input.

cards.originalTitle: Beyond Supra-Competitive Outcomes: Collusive Behaviour in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Execution Games
cards.titleEn: Learned Punishment Mechanisms and Collusive Behaviour in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Execution Games
cards.descriptionEn: In a two-player finite-horizon Almgren-Chriss liquidation game, independent PPO agents learn a punitive mechanism: after a deviation, the opponent accelerates liquidation, offsetting the deviator's gain while its own average payoff remains materially unchanged, providing behavioural and economic evidence for a collusive interpretation of supra-competitive outcomes.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study moves beyond documenting supra-competitive outcomes in deep reinforcement learning for optimal-execution games toward an economic explanation based on a learned punishment mechanism and collusive behaviour. It offers an analytical framework for understanding tacit coordination among learning trading agents and its potential effects on market execution costs.
keyPoints: 独立PPO智能体在两人有限期Almgren-Chriss清算博弈中取得低于Nash基准的成本。
对手面对偏离时加速清算，抵消偏离者收益且惩罚者自身平均收益基本不变。
惩罚收益是否超过偏离收益、行为变化是否足以解释损失这两项检验在该偏离下均成立。
cards.summaryEn: The paper extends earlier findings of supra-competitive outcomes in optimal-execution games by identifying a learned punitive mechanism and providing behavioural evidence of collusion. In a two-player finite-horizon Almgren-Chriss liquidation game, independent PPO agents with access to within-episode price and action histories achieve costs below the Nash benchmark; the authors train a profitable deviation against the mean learned liquidation schedule and impose its first trade on one original agent, and the opponent responds by accelerating liquidation. The authors argue that punishment outweighs the deviation gain and that the change in trading behaviour is large enough to account for the loss, so both checks support a collusive interpretation; this interpretation is advanced by the authors for their specific experimental setting.
cards.summary: 论文扩展了最优执行博弈中早期发现的超竞争性结果，识别出智能体习得的一种惩罚机制，并给出合谋的行为证据。在两人有限期Almgren-Chriss清算博弈中，拥有价格与行动历史信息的独立PPO智能体实现了低于Nash基准的成本；作者通过针对平均学习清算计划训练出有利可图的偏离，并将该偏离的第一笔交易施加于原智能体上，观察到对手加速清算。作者认为惩罚收益超过偏离收益、交易行为变化足以解释损失，两项检验均成立，因而支持合谋解读；这些结论属于作者在特定实验设定下的解释。
cards.limitations: 证据来自两人、有限期、特定参数下的Almgren-Chriss清算博弈与独立PPO智能体，偏离检验只针对一种由平均学习清算计划构造的偏离。结论是否适用于更多参与者、不同市场结构、其他强化学习算法或真实市场数据，原文未提供证据。合谋解释属于作者基于行为与经济检验提出的解读，并非对真实市场合谋的直接证明。
keyPointsEn: Independent PPO agents achieve costs below the Nash benchmark in a two-player finite-horizon Almgren-Chriss liquidation game.
When facing a deviation, the opponent accelerates liquidation, offsetting the deviator's gain while the punisher's average payoff remains materially unchanged.
Two checks hold for the tested deviation: whether punishment outweighs the deviation gain, and whether the change in trading behaviour is large enough to account for the loss imposed.
cards.description: 该研究在两人有限期Almgren-Chriss清算博弈中，识别出独立PPO智能体习得的惩罚机制：面对偏离行为，对手加速清算，使偏离者收益被抵消而惩罚者自身平均收益基本不变，为超竞争性结果提供了行为与经济层面的合谋证据。
cards.title: 深度强化学习在最优执行博弈中习得惩罚机制与合谋行为
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究将深度强化学习在最优执行博弈中出现的超竞争性结果，从单纯结果观察推进到对惩罚机制与合谋行为的经济解释，为理解学习型交易智能体可能形成的默契协同及其对市场执行成本的影响提供了分析框架。
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes from a two-player, finite-horizon Almgren-Chriss liquidation game with a specific parameterization and independent PPO agents, and the deviation test targets only one deviation constructed against the mean learned liquidation schedule. The source does not provide evidence on whether the conclusions extend to more participants, different market structures, other reinforcement learning algorithms, or real market data. The collusive interpretation is the authors' reading based on behavioural and economic checks, not direct proof of collusion in real markets.

cards.originalTitle: Negative Oil & Nickel Squeeze: A Feedback Model for Extreme Commodity Futures Prices
cards.titleEn: Negative Oil and Nickel Squeeze: A Feedback Model for Extreme Commodity Futures Prices
cards.descriptionEn: This study presents a feedback model linking futures price distortion under physical delivery constraints to roll option value and long-short position imbalance, with an explicit solution under lognormal benchmark dynamics that can explain negative prices arising from a positive-price model. Its value lies in a unified characterization of extreme events like the 2020 WTI negative oil price and the 2022 nickel squeeze.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Extreme commodity futures price events are difficult to explain with traditional positive-price models; this framework offers an analytically tractable way to understand the feedback among delivery constraints, position imbalance, and option pricing.
keyPoints: 模型将对实物交割受限的多空失衡转化为对期货价格的反馈修正，并联系到滚动期权。
在对数正态基准下，滚动期权价值满足非线性定价PDE，并可显式表达为经典交换期权公式，只需求解一个标量方程。
同一构造可切换为Bachelier正态动态，并用WTI与镍的示例说明复现极端价格所需的持仓失衡程度。
cards.summaryEn: On April 20, 2020, the May WTI contract fell from about $17 to an intraday low of -$40.32 and settled at -$37.63 one day before expiry, while a nickel squeeze occurred in March 2022. The authors propose a feedback model linking price distortion to a roll option and delivery-constrained long-short imbalance. The fact is that the model has an explicit solution via classical Black-Scholes-Margrabe exchange option formulas; the authors' view is that this can generate negative prices under a positive-price lognormal benchmark.
cards.summary: 2020年4月20日，WTI五月合约在到期前一日从约17美元跌至盘中-40.32美元、结算-37.63美元；2022年3月镍市场也出现逼空。作者提出反馈模型，把价格扭曲与滚动期权及交割约束下多空失衡相连。事实是模型在经典Black-Scholes-Margrabe交换期权公式下存在显式解；作者观点是这能在正价格对数正态基准下产生负价格。
cards.limitations: 摘要仅说明模型在基准假设下可复现极端事件价格，未给出实证拟合、参数估计或样本外检验；负价格结果依赖模型设定与示例性失衡假设，不能直接用于预测或交易决策。
keyPointsEn: The model translates delivery-constrained long-short imbalance into a feedback correction to futures prices and connects it to a roll option.
Under lognormal benchmark dynamics, the roll option value satisfies a nonlinear pricing PDE and admits an explicit expression via classical exchange option formulas, up to solving a scalar equation.
The same construction can switch to Bachelier normal dynamics, and illustrations based on WTI and nickel show the imbalance required to reproduce extreme event prices.
cards.description: 该研究用一个反馈模型将实物交割约束下的期货价格扭曲与滚动期权价值及多空持仓失衡联系起来，并在对数正态基准下给出显式解，可解释正价格模型中出现负价格的现象。其价值在于为2020年WTI负油价和2022年镍逼空这类极端事件提供统一刻画。
cards.title: 负油价与镍逼空：商品期货极端价格的反馈模型
cards.whyItMatters: 极端商品期货价格事件难以用传统正价格模型解释，该框架为理解交割约束、持仓失衡与期权定价之间的反馈机制提供了可解析处理的思路。
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract only states that the model can reproduce extreme event prices under benchmark assumptions; it provides no empirical fitting, parameter estimation, or out-of-sample tests. Negative price results depend on model settings and illustrative imbalance assumptions and should not be used directly for forecasting or trading decisions.

cards.titleEn: Effect-TS: A TypeScript Framework for Production-Ready Applications
cards.descriptionEn: This repository appears as a GitHub daily trending project, with its description emphasizing building production-ready applications in TypeScript. It offers a TypeScript-based architectural and tooling approach aimed at helping developers handle real-world production complexities. For TypeScript developers, this represents a possible option aligned with production requirements when building robust, maintainable applications.
cards.whyItMattersEn: For developers focused on TypeScript production practices, this project may offer a framework or toolset worth evaluating. Without detailed documentation in the direct input, its value needs further judgment based on actual code and use cases.
keyPoints: 仓库定位为使用 TypeScript 构建生产级应用。
项目在 GitHub Trending Daily 中被收录。
仓库描述简洁，未展开具体实现方式。
cards.summaryEn: Effect-TS/effect is a GitHub project described as being for building production-ready TypeScript applications. Its repository summary only briefly states 'Build production-ready applications in TypeScript' without further technical details or feature explanations. The author's views or project motivation cannot be confirmed from the provided information.
cards.summary: Effect-TS/effect 是一个在 GitHub 上被标注为用于构建生产级 TypeScript 应用的项目。其仓库摘要仅简短说明“使用 TypeScript 构建生产就绪的应用程序”，并未提供更多技术细节或功能说明。作者观点或项目动机在给定信息中无法确认。
cards.limitations: 给定输入仅包含仓库标题、简短描述和趋势收录信息，缺少项目文档、代码示例、基准测试或用户反馈。因此无法可靠评估其生产适用性、性能表现或具体功能。所有内容均不能视为对项目质量的背书或投资建议。
keyPointsEn: The repository is positioned for building production-ready applications with TypeScript.
It was listed in GitHub Trending Daily.
The repository description is brief and does not elaborate on concrete implementation.
cards.description: 该仓库作为 GitHub 每日趋势项目，其描述强调使用 TypeScript 构建生产级应用。它提供了基于 TypeScript 的架构与工具方案，旨在帮助开发者应对实际生产场景中的复杂性需求。对于 TypeScript 开发者而言，这意味着在构建健壮、可维护的应用时，多了一个可能贴合生产要求的选项。
cards.title: Effect-TS：面向生产环境的 TypeScript 应用框架
cards.whyItMatters: 对于关注 TypeScript 生产实践的开发者，该项目可能提供一个值得评估的框架或工具集。在缺乏详细文档的直接输入下，其价值需结合实际代码与场景进一步判断。
cards.limitationsEn: The given input only includes the repository title, a short description, and trending listing information, lacking project documentation, code examples, benchmarks, or user feedback. Therefore, its production suitability, performance, or specific features cannot be reliably assessed. Nothing here should be taken as an endorsement of project quality or as investment advice.

cards.originalTitle: Portfolio Choice under General Utility with Transaction Costs and Search Frictions
cards.titleEn: Portfolio Choice under General Utility with Transaction Costs and Search Frictions
cards.descriptionEn: This paper studies finite-horizon portfolio optimization with proportional transaction costs and trading opportunities arriving at the jump times of a Cox process, allowing utility functions that need not be concave, increasing, or differentiable. Its novelty lies in reducing a semi-linear nonlocal HJB equation with control entering only through a zeroth-order term to a form with a unique bounded solution, leading to an optimal Markovian feedback strategy and numerical exampl
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work incorporates non-concave utility into a portfolio choice framework with transaction costs and randomly arriving trading opportunities, offering a verifiable mathematical structure for optimal strategies under nonstandard preferences in frictional markets and indicating that the usual ordering and interval structure may fail relative to smooth concave utility.
keyPoints: 模型允许非凹、非增、不可微效用，并包含比例交易成本与 Cox 过程到达的随机交易机会。
通过压缩论证与内部 Schauder 估计证明归一化 HJB 方程存在唯一有界解，并完成验证。
非凹效用的数值示例显示同一交易动作对应多个区间、偏离买入—不交易—卖出次序及最优风险权重突变。
cards.summaryEn: The authors study finite-horizon portfolio optimization with proportional transaction costs and trading opportunities arriving at the jump times of a Cox process, with no borrowing or short-selling and utility functions not required to be concave, increasing, or differentiable. As a factual contribution, they show that the normalized HJB equation admits a unique bounded solution that is continuous and classical in time and log-price, and they verify the value function and obtain an optimal Markovian feedback strategy. The authors argue that non-concave utilities produce numerical features such as multiple intervals for the same trading action, departures from the usual buy--no-trade--sell ordering, and abrupt switches in the optimal post-trade risky weight, though these are numerical examples rather than general conclusions.
cards.summary: 作者研究有限期限组合优化，交易机会按 Cox 过程跳跃到达且存在比例交易成本，禁止借贷与卖空，效用函数不要求凹、增或可微。事实层面，作者证明归一化 HJB 方程有唯一有界解且连续、关于时间与对数价格经典可微，并通过验证定理识别值函数与最优马尔可夫反馈策略。作者观点认为，非凹效用会产生同一交易动作对应多个区间、偏离常规买入—不交易—卖出次序以及最优风险权重突变等数值特征，但这些现象来自其数值示例而非普遍结论。
cards.limitations: 结论限于有限期限、比例交易成本、禁止借贷与卖空、交易机会服从 Cox 过程跳跃到达的特定设定；效用类虽放宽但仍受技术条件约束，例如包含渐近弹性大于等于一的可微效用。非凹效用导致的多区间、次序偏离和权重突变仅为数值示例，未经实证检验，也不构成投资建议；唯一性与光滑性依赖归一化方程、压缩论证与 Schauder 估计所需的正则性假设。
keyPointsEn: The model allows non-concave, non-increasing, and non-differentiable utilities, and includes proportional transaction costs and random trading opportunities arriving via a Cox process.
A contraction argument combined with interior Schauder estimates proves a unique bounded solution to the normalized HJB equation, followed by verification.
Numerical examples with non-concave utilities show multiple intervals for the same trading action, departures from the buy--no-trade--sell ordering, and abrupt switches in the optimal risky weight.
cards.description: 本文在有限期限组合优化中同时引入比例交易成本与 Cox 过程跳跃到达的交易机会，并允许效用函数非凹、非增、不可微。其新意在于将控制仅进入零阶项的半线性非局部 HJB 方程化为可证唯一有界解的形式，并给出最优马尔可夫反馈策略；数值上展示了非凹效用导致的买入—不交易—卖出次序偏离等新现象，对摩擦市场下的组合决策具有参考价值。
cards.title: 交易成本与随机搜索摩擦下的广义效用组合选择
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作将非凹效用纳入带交易成本且交易机会随机到达的组合选择框架，为分析摩擦市场中非标准偏好下的最优策略提供了可验证的数学结构，并提示传统平滑凹效用下的策略排序与区间结构可能失效。
cards.limitationsEn: The results are confined to the specific setting of finite horizon, proportional transaction costs, no borrowing or short-selling, and trading opportunities arriving at jump times of a Cox process; although the utility class is relaxed, technical conditions remain, such as including differentiable utilities with asymptotic elasticity greater than or equal to one. The multiple intervals, ordering departures, and weight switches under non-concave utility are numerical examples only, not empirically tested and not investment advice; uniqueness and smoothness rely on regularity assumptions needed for the normalized equation, contraction argument, and Schauder estimates.

cards.originalTitle: Price Discovery at the Boundary of Contractual Decidability: Terminal-Value Gaps, Trading Availability, and Venue Finality on Kalshi
cards.titleEn: Price Discovery at the Boundary of Contractual Decidability: Study Design for Kalshi
cards.descriptionEn: This paper anchors price discovery research to contractual decidability rather than an arbitrary venue label, proposing a prospective primary cohort and a targeted pilot protocol. Its usefulness lies in specifying cohort, clock, and data-eligibility criteria for later price estimation, not in supplying price conclusions.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The design shifts the precondition of price discovery research from venue labels to contractual decidability, helping separate a reaction cohort still tradable after decidability from a stale-terminal cohort closed before decidability. Treating closure as a competing event for convergence rather than ordinary missingness may matter for causal interpretation in later estimates.
keyPoints: 研究以合约可判定性时钟而非任意场所标签组织价格发现分析，历史场馆端点不提供该时钟。
已完成的历史恢复未产生历史上可接受的合约可判定性队列，前瞻性基础设施调试已通过且证据登记活跃，但生产价格提取尚未开始。
主要队列将来自前瞻性登记并经盲审裁定的可判定性框架，需接受精确或区间首个可判定性时钟、精确终端偿付、交易可用性分类及有界非区块交易或真实蜡烛覆盖。
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies price discovery around the boundary of contractual decidability, treating decidability as the research anchor rather than a venue label. The author plans a prospective primary binary cohort and designs a 20-market pilot intended only to validate acquisition, block-trade treatment, synthetic-candle rejection, staleness, and clock alignment. No price estimates are reported; price estimation awaits independently reconstructed first/stable-decidability clocks and source-release clusters.
cards.summary: 论文关注合约可判定性边界附近的价格发现，将可判定性视为研究锚点而非场所标签。作者规划了一个前瞻性主要二元队列，并设计了仅用于验证数据获取、区块交易处理、合成蜡烛拒绝、陈旧性和时钟对齐的20市场试点。论文未报告任何价格估计，价格估计需等待独立重建的首个/稳定可判定性时钟与来源释放聚类。
cards.limitations: 论文仅为研究设计与试点协议，不含价格估计。历史恢复未产生可接受的合约可判定性队列；生产价格提取尚未启动；试点仅能验证获取、区块交易处理、合成蜡烛拒绝、陈旧性和时钟对齐，不产生价格估计。价格估计依赖未来独立重建的首个/稳定可判定性时钟和来源释放聚类，且不允许广泛交易所级交易爬取或事后时钟替换。
keyPointsEn: The study organizes price discovery analysis around a contractual-decidability clock rather than an arbitrary venue label; historical venue endpoints do not supply that clock.

The completed historical recovery produced no historically admissible contractual-decidability cohort; prospective infrastructure shakedown has passed and evidence enrollment is active, but production price extraction has not started.

The primary cohort will be drawn from the prospectively enrolled, blind-adjudicated decidability frame, requiring an accepted exact or interval first-decidability clock, exact terminal payoff, trading-availability classification, and admissible bounded non-block trade or real-candle coverage.
cards.description: 该论文将价格发现研究锚定在合约可判定性而非任意场所标签上，提出了前瞻性主要队列与针对性试点协议。其有用性在于为后续价格估计提供了明确的队列、时钟与数据资格标准，而非直接给出价格结论。
cards.title: Kalshi 合约可判定边界处的价格发现研究设计
cards.whyItMatters: 该设计将价格发现研究的前提条件从场所标签转向合约可判定性，有助于区分可判定后仍可交易的反应队列与判定前已关闭的陈旧终端队列。封闭被视为收敛的竞争事件而非普通缺失，这一区分对后续估计的因果解释具有潜在影响。
cards.limitationsEn: The paper is a study design and pilot protocol only; it contains no price estimates. Historical recovery yielded no acceptable contractual-decidability cohort; production price extraction has not begun; the pilot can only validate acquisition, block-trade treatment, synthetic-candle rejection, staleness, and clock alignment, and does not produce price estimates. Price estimation depends on future independently reconstructed first/stable-decidability clocks and source-release clusters, and no broad exchange-wide trade crawl or post hoc clock substitution is permitted.

cards.originalTitle: Recent Quant Links from Quantocracy as of 10/02/2026
cards.titleEn: Quant Links Roundup: Large-Scale Tests and Few Confirmed Findings
cards.descriptionEn: Quantocracy's recent quant links roundup includes a report of about 897,000 tests across roughly 150 pattern families, yielding only one confirmed finding, highlighting multiple-testing concerns.
cards.whyItMattersEn: When many tests are run but few findings are confirmed, quant research should account for multiple-testing bias and result robustness, avoiding mistaking spurious correlations for real patterns.
